note: Counted by hand from the 'Supported Regions for AWS Artifact service-linked roles' table on https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/using-service-linked-roles.html before the parser was written. The table has 25 data rows. The 'Support in AWS Artifact' cell says Yes on 3 rows (us-east-1, us-west-2, us-gov-west-1) and No on the other 22, so the numerator is 3 and 22 ids are exclusions. The prose says AWS Artifact 'does not support using service-linked roles in every Region where the service is available', so the table is the whole story and coverage is enumerated, never universe-minus-exclusions. 3 + 22 = 25, which is less than the 46-Region universe: the table simply does not name the other 21 Regions. No row is partial.
